mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, 'ORG' AS subject_type, o.org_id AS subject_id, o.path_code AS subject_path FROM po_users_organization u JOIN po_organization o ON o.org_id = u.org_id WHERE u.user_id IN UNION ALL SELECT u.user_id, 'POST' AS subject_type, p.position_id AS subject_id, NULL AS subject_path FROM po_users_organization u JOIN po_position p ON p.position_id = u.position_id WHERE p.is_digital_position = 0 AND u.user_id IN UNION ALL SELECT u.user_id, 'STATION' AS subject_type, s.station_id AS subject_id, s.station_id_path AS subject_path FROM po_users u JOIN po_station s ON s.station_id = u.station_id WHERE u.user_id IN
